preserved_facts: All 145 records compared with installed source. Council formal register remains distinct from individual Fwiffo.
Dynamic captain then ship insertion order retained; acting captain title preserved without name replacement.
Correct and deliberately wrong ciphers remain distinct; two chances and immediate-destruction condition unchanged.
Evil Ones and Ultimate Evil remain different names. Unknown origin stays unknown; imaginary Precursor invisibility shield stays belief.
Thirty years return prediction; six other Hierarchy members; ten artificial waste sites; ten thousand comparable ships retained.
Bronze to atomic technology in less than a century; three hundred years on moon; ten to fifteen years resettlement delay preserved.
Eradication quest requires all creatures; incomplete progress, premature claim, first lie and permanent-enemy second lie remain distinct.
Young and infirm sent first remains the original dark joke; threatened return of creatures preserves player coercion.
Fop-Dope-Bic misremembered name and Council belief about Androsynth/Orz preserved; claim of eating immediately qualified.
Eight-year Jud the Vug incident; interrupted shield slip and unanswered Ur-Quan ritual story retain concealed information.
limitations: Agent semantic review only. Human style review, voice timing, quest branches and rendered layout remain pending.
